description: ONE frame of the film at full size (1920×1080 in 16:9), to read small text or check a detail a contact sheet is too small for. Give a time in seconds (at) or a shot number (taken once its elements have arrived); without either, the first shot. A film that uses Pro pieces, on a plan without Pro, is shown at half size: a full-size frame of it is a poster, which exports with Pro (export_poster).

at.description: A time in seconds from the start of the film

format.description: Look at another format than the film's own

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

png.description: true for a PNG without loss (heavier). Default: JPEG

shot.description: A shot (1 = first), shown once its elements have arrived

name: still_film
title: Look at one frame
